question: which cell analysis technique is used to rapidly analyse single cells or particles as they flow through single or multiple lasers while suspended in a buffered salt-based solution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Flow cytometry.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Flow cytometry is the cell analysis technique used to rapidly analyze single cells or particles as they flow through single or multiple lasers while suspended in a buffered salt-based solution.**
 
• This technique can analyze thousands of cells** per second, making it an efficient way to study large populations of cells.**
 
• Flow cytometry can be used to analyze various cell characteristics such as **size, shape, and protein expression.**
 
• This technique is commonly used in **medical research, clinical diagnostics, and drug development.**
 
• Mass spectroscopy is a technique used to identify the chemical composition of a substance, while electrochemical analysis involves measuring the electrical properties of a substance. Multiple displacement amplification is a technique used to amplify small amounts of DNA.
